title: 7-Day Chiva-Som Hua Hin Luxury Wellness & Championship Golf
description: World-renowned health sanctuary at Chiva-Som. Pair holistic wellness treatments with rounds at Black Mountain, Pineapple Valley, and Springfield Royal.

signatureTour.title: The Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our comprehensive dual-destination signature tour combining Bangkok’s vibrant city life with Hua Hin’s royal golf heritage.

inclusions.detail: Executive chauffeured vehicles for all transfers between Bangkok and Hua Hin.
3 rounds: Black Mountain, Pineapple Valley, and Springfield Royal.
6 nights in an Ocean View Room at Chiva-Som International Health Resort.
One bespoke wellness treatment per night of stay (massages, hydrotherapy, bodywork).
All three daily wellness meals crafted by Chiva-Som’s wellness culinary team.

itinerary.title: Executive Transit to Hua Hin & Holistic Wellness Consultation
itinerary.subtitle: Sanctuary Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Chiva-Som Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Chiva-Som Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Meet your private chauffeur at Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi Airport for an executive journey south along the Gulf of Thailand to Chiva-Som International Health Resort in Hua Hin. Settle into your Ocean View room and begin your holistic intake consultation with a dedicated health and wellness advisor.

Enjoy your first nutrient-rich wellness dinner overlooking the Gulf, designed to restore digestive harmony and prepare your body for the physical demands of championship golf.

itinerary.title: Championship Majesty at Black Mountain Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: European Tour Venue
itinerary.imageCaption: Black Mountain Golf Club — Phil Ryan (Par 72, 7,375 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Black Mountain Golf Club championship golf course Phil Ryan Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Black Mountain Golf Club, Hua Hin's internationally acclaimed European Tour venue. Set in a natural valley against dramatic black granite bluffs, this 27-hole layout features impeccably manicured fairways and rapid, tiered greens.

Return to Chiva-Som for a late-afternoon deep-tissue sports massage specifically targeting the golfer’s lumbar and shoulder rotational muscles.

itinerary.title: Sublime Mountain Vistas at Pineapple Valley Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Schmidt-Curley Masterpiece
itinerary.imageCaption: Pineapple Valley Golf Club — Pirapon Namatra / Golf East (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Pineapple Valley Golf Club championship golf course Pirapon Namatra / Golf East Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle Pineapple Valley Golf Club (formerly Banyan Golf Club), designed by Pirapon Namatra. Carved through historic pineapple plantations, the layout offers stunning views of the Burmese mountain ranges from its signature hilltop clubhouse.

Back at Chiva-Som, enjoy an evening hydrotherapy flotation session to completely relieve joint pressure and enhance restful sleep.

itinerary.title: Comprehensive Physical Restoration & Hydrotherapy
itinerary.subtitle: Holistic Recovery Day
itinerary.imageCaption: Chiva-Som Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Chiva-Som Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
A dedicated wellness immersion day with zero transfers. Participate in sunrise pranayama breathing on the beach, followed by private physiotherapy analysis and personalized mobility stretching.

Savor an organic farm-to-table lunch and spend the afternoon reading in the tranquil wellness pavilions.

itinerary.title: Jack Nicklaus Design at Springfield Royal Country Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Classic Nicklaus Challenge
itinerary.imageCaption: Springfield Royal Country Club — Jack Nicklaus (A/B) / Lee Schmidt (C) (Par 72 (A/B) / 36 (C), 7,063 Yards (A/B))
itinerary.imageAlt: Springfield Royal Country Club championship golf course Jack Nicklaus (A/B) / Lee Schmidt (C) Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take on Jack Nicklaus’s classic 27-hole creation at Springfield Royal Country Club. Featuring sweeping waste bunkering, generous fairways, and challenging water hazards, Nicklaus’s design rewards strategic placement and bold shot-making.

Conclude your golf circuit and return to Chiva-Som for an invigorating herbal steam session and restorative body therapy.

itinerary.title: Mindful Beachfront Meditation & Farewell Dinner
itinerary.subtitle: Sanctuary Farewell
itinerary.imageCaption: Chiva-Som Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Chiva-Som Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Spend a mindful final day at Chiva-Som, reflecting on your physical restoration and improved vitality after a week of balanced wellness and golf.

Gather for a celebratory wellness farewell dinner, enjoying creative culinary masterpieces crafted without refined sugars or artificial additives.

itinerary.title: Executive Return Transfer to Bangkok Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Chiva-Som Hua Hin — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Chiva-Som Hua Hin luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a final nourishing breakfast before completing checkout with your Chiva-Som wellness coordinator.

Your private executive chauffeur transports you smoothly back to Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport for your flight home, feeling entirely revitalized.

faqs.question: What is included in Chiva-Som’s wellness program?
faqs.answer: Each guest receives an individual health consultation, three wellness meals daily, physical analysis, and one daily restorative treatment.
